pr.body:
Heavy's Siege Gunner gains a handling fork after Feed Clutch. Keyed Clutch lets the player crank the lifted barrel and re-engage at its actual bearing, committing the remaining stroke to that lane. Open Feed permits ordinary primary while lifted; each paid round trades one remaining original C opportunity, even when a mutation creates several pellets. Both choices work with the three existing carriages. The plain route costs 9 SP, or 11 with a fitting. The catalog now contains Engineer's 22, Soldier's 28 and Heavy's 13 techniques; broader class development continues.

The stroke retains its original 0/10/20/30 firing opportunities, 31-tick window, magazine costs, recoil, physical cover, bodies, armor and recovery. Passed and traded opportunities remain distinct. Open checks capacity for the entire real volley before payment. Used operations retain their ownership dependencies; earlier shots keep their issued authority. Host exit removes tracked C shots, while ordinary primary keeps its separate authority. Friendly trajectories and removals stay owner-only, and real contact feedback is shared. Five owned action rows retain independent remaps and both saved HUD choices. The owner-only bearing marker depicts the actual barrel.

The latest source changes verification only. Helpers now distinguish paid rounds from physical projectiles, observe lifted walking under actual slow/recoil, separate C cleanup from primary and record mutation-scaled damage context. Sixteen direct-Game regressions include nine exact damage comparisons across carriages, Lifeline and Iron Rain. Bounded test-file concurrency overlaps real peer waits while preserving every test, check, policy and timeout. Committed runtime blobs remain exact since the original handling feature, 18da7f9.

Validation:

- Playable source **20aad19bdfb8819cd7db0483b9c79f2c6e9dcd5c**, build **2026.11.09-heavy-clutch-handling**, protocol **72**, content **cc0f92021ec2a1bb9d0b82a4a85bc6bc6f026655a90d77ae3362f36da929fba4**: **2,161 passing tests and all seven checks**, with zero failures, cancellations or skips. Source CI [push](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/42826929279) / [pull_request](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/42826959310) and separate metadata **c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035** CI [push](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/42865365533) / [pull_request](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/42865396031) have every job, step, decoded test log and fresh own-run runtime artifact checked.
- Testing **5380/2756** and local public review **5381/2757** each bind **2,052 files, 106 cases, 44 invocations and four native groups**: HTTP 1, source UI/control/prediction/private presentation 63, whole exact-served optimized workers 21 and real peers 21. Every handling/carriage combination earns Short 3→9→15 through two actual clears and makes source MenuDOM purchases. Peer cases put the Heavy owner in a Soldier-hosted room. No checkpoint, budget, health, position or hazard injection is used in those earned cases.
- Complete matrices compose successful executions with explicit attempt history. Original missing-module failures, later wall-clock-bound failures without terminal phase snapshots and a reporting retry that read mutations from the wrong view level remain preserved. Twelve entry cases were rerun with strictly checked pre-stroke context and copied real shot values. Original successful entry reports remain untouched. No timeout or policy changed, and no original execution receives retroactive fields.
- All 72 natural/replay pairs retain their original execution provenance. Combat/progression fields match; all 36 baseline natural and 36 baseline replay rows reproduce the earlier source71 measurements. The 36 new handling pairs retain 18 Gatehouse wins and 18 Triage losses, 515 strokes and 1,764 C rounds. Conversion observations remain partial; raw terminal-shield resets retain issued Practice provenance. Different General spending and one conservative policy do not rank builds or isolate win causes.

Raw byte hashes remain tied to their execution surface. Local frozen/natural runtime is **9703aee1a5b0a2b1691ccfa24b703fc8d6c022c838ea833d8f386a3fa19f113f**, with source/test snapshot **13a917a96504b02c86d4c19d3b9678d775adeaa893d7169fa458c5f141ed8552**. Linux CI matches committed Git runtime **f1f0a5ce43e7d052a10586742d7123106f48263eb073a892de953fa302c25275** and snapshot **8d5872b490a07d95ac56861acaae80de97fd6baefef7b1960e47b07f75130121**. The [source binding audit](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/blob/c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035/reviews/heavy-clutch-stat-scaling-2026-11-10/source-binding-audit04.json) enumerates five CRLF-only runtime files plus workspace YAML; parsed JSON and emitted TS/CSS match. The verification driver **207175ba295b17adf64bb9c63c7d00df507c4f0142faf9bcac7ea83dcf66e09b** is byte-identical locally, in Git and in CI. No checkout configuration changed, and these executions are not relabelled.

All 63 issued definitions/rules/emblems and previous values in 15 language catalogs remain exact. General retains 648 nodes, four shared techniques, 27 SP and one capstone; twelve class labels, equipment, balances, remaps and original Practice editions remain. Exact source71 ownership and all twelve profile/history rosters migrate before older guards. Local imports never become online proof. The next content change must admit exact72/cc0f92021ec2a1bb9d0b82a4a85bc6bc6f026655a90d77ae3362f36da929fba4/63 techniques/four General before71.

All 63 registered predecessor roots and the failed unregistered 2,045-file Seam root retain their bound bytes. Earlier passing, failed and cancelled gates/reviews remain evidence. No process cleanup or private SQLite upload occurred. Service Yard stays restorable, unregistered 4-pass/1-fail WIP outside this suite.

Evidence: [source verification](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/blob/c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035/reviews/heavy-clutch-stat-scaling-2026-11-10/source-verification.json), [frozen matrix and attempt history](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/blob/c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035/reviews/heavy-clutch-stat-scaling-2026-11-10/frozen-verification.json), [measurements](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/blob/c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035/reviews/heavy-clutch-stat-scaling-2026-11-10/natural-replay-summary.json), [design](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/blob/c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035/docs/HEAVY_CLUTCH_HANDLING_DESIGN.md), [continuation](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/blob/c09370e7ad51372b87bd00f06e211b4f9f7ad035/handoff/NEXT_CHAT.md).

Keep PR14 draft. Tethered Traverse remains an unregistered workspace study with mechanical, prediction, native-art, Scene, control and budget evidence; canonical earned purchases and transport proof are pending. Further pathways/classes, whole-class assessment and human/rendered/device/native-language/listening/motion/final-balance acceptance remain open. Only the user decides completion. No main merge, production deployment, Windows replacement, capacity purchase or browser automation is included.
